product.title: Fiat 500 Private Tour&Photoshoot with a Roman, Pick-up Included

description.text: See Rome from a vintage Fiat 500 with a private driver-guide who also shoots professional photos of your group. Hotel pickup is included when traffic rules allow, with a meeting point at Via delle Terme di Tito beside the Colosseum if the historic center is restricted. Stops include Colosseum, Via delle Terme di Tito. The private format keeps the route flexible for landmark photo stops around the ancient city. Ideal for visitors basing in Rome who want a guided city experience without coordinating Metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own. Routes stay oriented to Colosseum, Via delle Terme di Tito that define this Rome sightseeing experience, with a guide handling Metro connections, ticket windows, and neighborhood pacing so the day stays focused on the city rather than logistics.
